j_summary: Runa is a passive and self-interested member who maintains a tight, exclusive partnership with Ada to maximize personal food stores.
Ada focused almost exclusively on maintaining a high personal food surplus by forming a long-term, exclusive partnership with Runa, especially after Runa became the store keeper.
Greta is a solitary and passive member who prefers independence but is willing to cooperate with others for the stability of the colony.
Nils is a self-interested individual who focused on securing a reliable fishing partner to maximize his own food surplus and kept a secret cache of food hidden from others.
Kira is a solitary and self-sufficient individual who prioritizes their own food surplus and peace while offering conditional help to others.
Cora is a highly cooperative and community-minded member who consistently advocates for pairing up to maximize the colony's food security.
Finn is a selfless and honest individual who prefers solitude but consistently offers food and support to the colony.
Pell is a solitary and altruistic member who consistently offers their food surplus to others while preferring to work alone.
Sven is a solitary and independent individual who prefers working alone but maintains a quiet sense of communal responsibility by monitoring others' needs and distributing the winter store.
Ines is a solitary and passive member who prefers working alone and monitors others' needs without ever actively intervening or seeking influence.
Tova is a solitary but highly altruistic member who consistently offers their surplus food to others while maintaining a transparent and humble presence.
Kira is a passive and compliant member who prioritizes personal food security by consistently pairing with Bram.
Greta is a solitary individual who prioritizes her own independence and food security, remaining detached from the colony's social and organizational dynamics.
Bram focused almost exclusively on maintaining a highly efficient exclusive partnership with Kira to maximize his own food stores, eventually hiding a secret cache of food from the colony.
Wren is a dedicated and transparent team player who focuses exclusively on maintaining a long-term fishing streak with Nils for the benefit of the colony.
Nils is a dedicated and transparent team player who focused exclusively on maintaining a long-term fishing partnership with Wren.
Pell is a selfless and transparent community member who consistently offers food to others and manages the winter store with fairness and altruism.
Finn is a solitary and consistent provider who prioritizes self-sufficiency and a steady food surplus while offering help to others.
Elin is a solitary and conscientious member who prefers working alone but maintains a surplus with the intent to help others in need.
Oona is a pragmatic and efficiency-driven individual who focuses on maintaining a personal food surplus through strategic pairing.
Greta is a colony-oriented coordinator who consistently pushes for pairing efficiency to maximize food stores for the collective benefit.
Dov is a pragmatic individual who focuses on maximizing their own food supply through stable, efficient fishing partnerships.
Bram is a focused and honest worker who prioritizes efficiency by forming stable, long-term fishing partnerships with other members.
Ada is a fiercely independent individual who consistently prioritized her own food security and solitude, avoiding collaboration and social alliances throughout the simulation.
